status: Technical reconstruction of already-scored ACS plus a new-source feasibility study; not public preregistration

reconstruction.input: Only official ACS source ZIPs, source metadata and frozen configuration; no pretrained models or derived person/household arrays as model inputs
stages: Reconstruct 2017 national 100000-person training sample across all 51 states/DC
Refit only the source HGB actually used; rebuild full-source historical cell rates
Rebuild 2022 household training data and fixed age/sex reference from eight states
Refit the coarse/RF/HGB risk inputs actually used for CT designs
Build 2024 CT background/design before opening its already-scored target labels
Run all 2000 CT repetitions/16 methods in a new directory; compare saved estimates, variances, counts, resources and final metrics
reconstruction.pass_rule: Exact counts/resources/categories; estimates/variances numerical equivalence rtol 2e-10, atol 2e-12. All discrepancies disclosed; no retuning to match
reconstruction.exclusions: Does not reconstruct discarded predictor families, fivefold diagnostics or all other states/budgets; no claim of a new unseen holdout
